Name: Auto-Sorter Building
Author: AtlasV1224
Description:
Manually sorting your items always takes so much time, add in a bunch of mods that add new items and it takes even longer!

This mod can help! It adds a new building with 2 upgrades that can be built by Robin that
automatically sorts all your items by category into the chests on the inside
that you place!



[b][u][size=4]USAGE [/size][/u][/b]
To use it, this is all you need to do :
[list]
[*]Buy the building from Robin and wait for it to be constructed.[/*]
[*]Place a sign that can have an item displayed on it anywhere in the building.[/*]
[*]Place any kind of chest directly below the sign.[/*]
[*]Place an item on the sign with a category that matches the items you want to be stored in the chest.[/*]
[*]Optionally use a selector on the sign to filter based on the items data[/*]
[*]Then head on outside and place your items in the box to the right of the door or use Automate the transfer of items.[/*]
[*]When you close the box your items will be sorted automatically![/*]
[/list]The building can support any number of chests with signs inside!

[b][u]Multiple filters (OR type) on a single sign
[/u][/b]
[list]
[*]Hold another item with a different category[/*]
[*]Shift-interact with the existing sign, Repeat for each alternative[/*]
[*]Shift-interact with an already-added category again to remove it[/*]
[/list]A small `+N` badge shows the number of saved alternatives, and breaking the sign clears them.
For example, a sign displaying a sword with dagger and club added this way routes `Sword OR Dagger
OR Club` into the same chest. The sign cycles through its primary and Shift-added
sample items every two seconds so the complete filter remains visible in-game.

[b][u]Calcifer Custom Item Categories[/u][/b]
Objects using Calcifer's custom-category field keepboth that custom category and their underlying vanilla category for sorting. Those categories form an `AND` filter on a sign: for example, an object categorized as
`Junk Food` by Calcifer with the vanilla `Cooking` category creates `Junk Food + Cooking`. The more specific `Junk Food` chest is tried before a chest configured only for `Cooking`.


There are also some fall back features so that if it doesn't find a chest that matches, your items will still be safe!
[list]
[*]If the building finds 2 chests with categories that match but one doesn't
have enough space, It will place the remaining items in the other chest.[/*]
[*]if the building finds a chest with a category match but doesn't have
enough space, or there isn't a chest for that category, it will place the items in chest below an empty sign.[/*]
[*]If the building can't do either of these the items will be placed back into the box you placed your items in.[/*]
[/list]

[b][u][size=4]TRANSLATIONS[/size][/u][/b]
If you'd like to translate this mod, feel free to upload that translation yourself, just link back to this mod
[list]
[*]Don't use AI translation[/*]
[*]Don't upload the mods original files[/*]
[*]Fluency in target language is prefered, but not necessary[/*]
[/list]
